svg.title: Sumac
svg.desc: Hand-authored interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection of the cited primary reference. Approximate contours and standardized vivid colors; paint texture, photographic perspective and external framing omitted. Independent 2017 Lévy Gorvy primary dealer brochure supplies complete Tom Powel photograph and matching 188 × 160 cm dimensions. Asymmetric orange-red X on crimson rectangular ground is clearly visible; this replaces the former unresolved faint 1996 reference.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://levygorvy.com/wp-content/uploads/Miami-Basel-Brochure-2017-lo-res.pdf#page=7; record guggenheim1996-cat-33; visual review 2026-10-27. Pure-vector study; not a facsimile.
